source_title: Logitech launches limited-edition MX Master 4 Developer Edition mouse in India, priced at Rs 20,699 - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Logitech has expanded its premium peripherals portfolio in India with the launch of the MX Master 4 Developer Edition, a limited-edition version of its flagship productivity mouse designed specifically for software developers. The company said the special edition mouse combines the performance of the MX Master 4 with developer-inspired design elements, customisable controls and workflow features aimed at coding, AI-assisted development and multitasking.According to Logitech, the MX Master 4 Developer Edition has been created as a tribute to developers and the role they play in building digital products and services. The mouse features a distinctive design inspired by programming and software development culture, including laser-etched syntax symbols, markup tags, circuit traces and a "{Hello, World}" execution prompt across its matte-finish body. The device also includes several hidden references intended for developers. Among them are "0xFF + 1", a nod to World Programmers' Day, "09.17" referencing the Linux kernel release date and "!04.01" representing World Backup Day.Logitech said the design reflects the daily workflow of developers, from writing code and managing projects to debugging and working across multiple applications. The MX Master 4 Developer Edition builds on the feature set of Logitech's flagship MX Master 4 mouse. It includes customisable haptic feedback designed to assist with navigating large code repositories and switching between terminal windows.The mouse also features a dedicated Actions Ring button that provides one-click access to custom macros, shortcuts and AI coding assistants. Logitech says this can help developers streamline repetitive tasks and improve workflow efficiency.Another highlight is the company's MagSpeed Scroll Wheel, which can scroll through up to 1,000 lines per second while maintaining precise control for line-by-line navigation. Logitech describes it as its fastest, quietest and most accurate scrolling technology to date.Availability and priceThe Logitech MX Master 4 Developer Edition is being offered as a limited-edition product and is now available through Amazon India while stocks last.You use AI every day.
